adaptations: Use public build metadata in Settings.Global hecker_pif_config, written by native privileged Settings, instead of the Axion-wide spoof-manager/AIDL stack.
ActivityThread initializes only com.google.android.gms.unstable and com.android.vending. Native property virtualization, provider and optional signature hooks run only in the attestation process.
No Google Photos/game/keybox/TrickyStore hooks are installed. No certificate private keys or preselected stale fingerprint are shipped.
Malformed/empty/incomplete profiles leave the adapter inactive. Profiles are activated on target process restart.
Native virtualization is the upstream October 19 patch applied without fuzz to the pinned Android 17 SystemProperties JNI source.
verification: Source compilation and host regressions only. Full Android platform build and coral Play Integrity verdict testing required.
